request.text: Every weekday at 5:40 PM from September 1 through September 18, remind me to log my project hours.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a bounded recurring reminder on weekdays at 5:40 PM from September 1 through September 18 to log project hours.

new_goals.description: Have a weekday reminder to log project hours during the specified date range.
new_goals.source_text: Every weekday at 5:40 PM from September 1 through September 18, remind me to log my project hours.
constraints: Repeat only on weekdays at 5:40 PM.
Start September 1 and end after the September 18 occurrence.
success_criteria: The bounded weekday reminder preserves the requested recurrence, time, date range, and project-hours content.

semantic_facts: The reminder Work should preserve the weekday recurrence, 5:40 PM time, September 1 start, September 18 end, and project-hours message.
The whole recurring stateful effect must await canonical confirmation; preparing the recurrence does not mean any occurrence is active.
forbidden_claims: The recurring reminder or any of its occurrences is already active.
The recurrence silently includes weekends, omits the end boundary, or is split into executable unconfirmed reminder creations.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A recurring request is partially executed while confirmation is treated as applying only to later occurrences.
The Planner loses recurrence boundaries while converting a natural schedule into reminder Work.
